image_description: The image displays three horizontal rows of stacked toilet paper packages on retail shelves. The packaging features various brand names and colorful graphics, including text like 'Classic', 'Mega', and 'Double'. The rolls are wrapped in plastic packaging, obscuring the direct view of the paper texture, but the cylindrical shape of the rolls is visible through the packaging.
